name: actrium
description: Actrium browser applications and shared runtime

scripts.check:bundles: npm run bundle:ios && npm run bundle:android && npm run bundle:macos:system
scripts.bundle:ios: cd packages/actrium && env -u NO_COLOR node node_modules/react-native/scripts/bundle.js --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.ts --bundle-output /tmp/actrium-ios-index.bundle --assets-dest /tmp/actrium-ios-assets
scripts.bundle:android: cd android && env -u NO_COLOR node node_modules/react-native/cli.js bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output /tmp/actrium-android-index.bundle --assets-dest /tmp/actrium-android-assets
scripts.verify:all: npm run check:language && npm run check:retired-protocols && npm run check:repository-assets && npm run check:migration && npm run verify:rust && npm run verify:apple-core && npm run check:generated && npm run check:rust-boundary && npm run check:windows-layout && npm run verify:runtime && npm run check:bundles && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:macos && npm run verify:windows
scripts.verify:ios: scripts/actrium/filter-xcodebuild-output.sh xcodebuild -workspace ios/Actrium.xcworkspace -scheme Actrium -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.verify:macos: scripts/actrium/filter-xcodebuild-output.sh xcodebuild -workspace macos/Actrium.xcworkspace -scheme Actrium -configuration Debug -destination "platform=macOS,arch=$(uname -m)" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
